senses.gloss:
2. श्लेष, अस्, m. adhering or clinging to; em-
bracing, an embrace; union, junction, contact, prox-
imity; association, society, presence; a figure of
rhetoric, connection of words so as to admit of a
double meaning, verbal equivocation, paronomasia,
pun, irony, implied meaning.
—श्लेष-भित्तिक, अस्,
आ, अम्, resting on or adhering to a wall, (said to mean
simply ‘resting on.’)
—श्लेषार्थ (˚ष-अर्˚), अस्,
m. a meaning other than the literal one, a second
sense hidden in the obvious one, implied meaning.

श्लेषण, अम्, n. the act of adhering, embracing,
&c.
श्लेषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be embraced, &c.
श्लेषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, adhering, clinging to, embracing.

श्लेष्मक, अस्, m. phlegm, the watery or phleg-
matic humor.

श्लेष्मण, अस्, आ, अम्, phlegmatic; (आ), f. a
kind of plant (= तर्पणी).

श्लेष्मन्, आ, m. phlegm, rheum, the phlegmatic
humor, (one of the three humors of the body; see
धातु.)
—श्लेष्म-घ्न, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, removing
phlegm; (आ), f. Arabian jasmine; a kind of tree
(= केतक); (ई), f. Arabian jasmine; hogweed;
another plant (= ज्योतिष्मती); the three spices (=
त्रि-कटु).
—श्लेष्म-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced or
proceeding from phlegm.
—श्लेष्म-धातु, उस्, m.
the phlegmatic humor.
—श्लेष्म-ह, अस्, आ, अम्,
removing phlegm; (अस्), m. a medicinal plant (=
कट्-फल).
—श्लेष्मातिसार (˚म-अत्˚), अस्, m.
dysentery or diarrhœa produced by vitiated phlegm.
—श्लेष्मान्तक (˚म-अन्˚), अस्, m. ‘destroying
phlegm,’ a kind of plant (= पिच्छिल, बहु-वार).
—श्लेष्माश्रु (˚म-अश्˚), उ, n. a tear consisting
of phlegmatic humor.
—श्लेष्मौजस् (˚म-ओज्˚),
अस्, n. the phlegmatic humor.

श्लेष्मल, अस्, आ, अम्, phlegmatic, abounding or
affected with phlegm, &c.; (अस्), m. the plant Cordia
Myxa or Latifolia.
श्लेष्मात, अस्, m. a kind of tree, = श्लेष्मातक.

श्लेष्मातक, अस्, m. the tree Cordia Myxa.
—श्ले-
ष्मातक-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of Cordia Myxa.
—श्लेष्मातक-वन, अम्, n. ‘forest of Śleṣmā-
taka trees,’ N. of a forest about Go-karṇa (where
Śiva is said to have been concealed in the form of a
stag).
